kind: Independent full ordinary-file copy; not incremental and not hard-linked to source or old backup.
link_policy: Reparse entries are saved in links.json only. No live links or external target contents are present in content/. Restore link definitions separately after reviewing destinations.
verification: Every ordinary file copied via .partial and read back; source and copy rehashed independently; file sets, ordinary directory sets and source link definitions stable.
limitations: File bytes, ordinary directories, link definitions and basic timestamps are covered. ACLs, alternate data streams, external dependencies and filesystem-wide atomic snapshot semantics are not certified.
